description: This header file defines casting templates such as implicit_cast and bit_cast for specialized type conversions in C++. It includes licensing information, includes necessary headers, and provides template implementations for safe casting operations, along with detailed comments and examples.

methods.name: implicit_cast
methods.description: Performs an implicit conversion between types following C++ language rules, allowing explicit annotation of implicit conversions.

methods.name: bit_cast
methods.description: Creates a new value of type Dest with the same bitwise representation as the source value of type Source, used for type punning with safety considerations.
